### Reviewed component details
ChatTool renders a compact, rounded card with an accordion header showing an AI tool invocation. The header displays status icons alongside a state label and tool name: a spinning Loader2 while running, a green Check upon completion, a red AlertCircle on failure, and a Wrench during streaming. When expanded, it reveals vertically stacked, preformatted code blocks for input arguments, output results, and a highlighted destructive banner for error text.

Behavior & Controls: A single collapsible trigger toggles the inspection panel open or closed. The component extracts tool names from dynamic or typed message parts, converts string or object payloads into formatted JSON strings, and dynamically displays only available inputs, outputs, or error states.

Accessibility: Leveraging Radix UI Accordion semantics via shadcn/ui, the trigger is an accessible button supporting full keyboard navigation (Space, Enter, and Arrow keys) with ARIA expansion attributes (aria-expanded, aria-controls). ### Reviewed component details
Appearance: Renders text with a directional, streak-like motion blur illusion produced through stacked CSS text-shadow layers positioned along a specified degree trajectory in white or black, with optional bidirectional trailing shadows.

Behavior: A client-rendered component that calculates a multi-layered CSS textShadow string using basic trigonometry. It does not feature dynamic animations or physics loops, generating purely static shadow offsets, incremental blur radiuses, and decaying opacity steps.
